This data set contains one hundred and forty-four files (.tif, .twf, .prj) that create an orthomosaic image of sites EaPd-07 and EaPd-08. This data was created from 1409 images collected through UAV photogrammetry with a DJI Phantom 4 and Pix4D Mapper 4.2.26. The data was collected by the Capture 2 Preserve team between May and June of 2018.
